main_text.p: Basilicis meminit in aliis Epistolis Mori-nus; scripsit enim Lucæ Holstenio (b), hac in re non parum adjutum fuisse Leo-nis Allatii monitis & lucubratiunculis a-liquot, in iis potissimum, quæ hodiernas Græcorum Ecclesias spectant. De Pa-schatis autem scripsit nonnulla Morinus, tam ex Judæorum quàm Christianorum sententia, ad Godofridum Vendelinum, de quo jam supra; quibus autem rationi-bus ad scribendum de Sacramento Con-firmationis adductus fuerit, ex hisce[?] Epi-stolis cognoscere non potui; liceat tamē suspicari, jā inde ab eo tempore, quo Romæ commorabatur, de illa scriptione cogitasse: nam video, opusculum Lucæ Holstenii de hoc argumento post e-jus obitum à Cardinale Francisco Barbe-rino Romæ editum fuisse, in quo Holstenius Ecclesiæ Orientalis ritus, quo in hoc negotio contrarii erant Ecclesiæ occiden-talis moribus, strenuè vindicat. Simulq; Theologorum Scholasticorum imperi-tiam & disputandi de rebus omnibus

page.notes: Space missing as printed between "Leo-nis" and "Allatii" and in "nonnulla Morinus" (printed joined: "nonnullaMorinus"); spaces added here. "hisce" is hard to read: the printed letters look like "hilce" [?]. Marks over "tamē" and "jā" are the printed tilde/macron for omitted n and m. Right edge of the scan is damaged and shows show-through; nothing from it is transcribed.
